request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Maintain and develop Eternl frontend across web, browser extension, Android, iOS, and beta channels
Maintain backend infrastructure including multi-region servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync/indexers, app servers, metadata aggregation, and monitoring
Provide Discord and Telegram user support, bug triage, ecosystem project support, wiki updates, and educational videos
Introduce Eternl Pro plans priced at $96/year for Personal and $360/year for Company
Convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place funds in a public company wallet, and return Ada above that amount to the treasury
Commission independent fund-use audits in February 2027 and August 2027
Publish Pro plan earnings reports and repayment or donation transaction hashes
Continue work on Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, enhanced hardware wallet support, wallet data export, and governance tooling
request.what: 12 months of operations, maintenance, and improvements for the Eternl Cardano light wallet, including frontend, backend, infrastructure, support, administration, audits, and governance tooling.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet available on web, browser extension, Android, and iOS.
The proposal asks for ₳2,350,000 at about $0.1787 per Ada to cover approximately $420,000 of annual costs for 12 months.
The team says 10 people contribute to Eternl and this proposal funds 6.0 FTE at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce paid Pro plans at $96/year for personal users and $360/year for company users, and says about 5,500 paying users would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
Eternl states it has about 100,000 browser extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
The proposal commits to converting up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, holding funds in a public company wallet, and returning Ada above that amount to the treasury.
The proposal says independent audits of treasury fund use will be performed in February 2027 and August 2027 by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team.
The proposer says 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The main Eternl UI will not be open-source, though some libraries used in Eternl will be published through the Eternl npm organization.
The proposer says that without treasury funding, Eternl may need to let developers go, scale down to essential maintenance, focus outside the Cardano ecosystem, or remove the free option.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for a 12-month Eternl sustainability plan administered by Tastenkunst GmbH, with stated operating costs of $420,000, a planned Pro subscription path, public wallet and repayment commitments, and independent fund-use audits, but several key adoption and impact claims are asserted without evidence in the anchor text.
